Hi Danielle—

Thanks for the note and context. We're happy to share the latest materials for the hosted API. High-level options we support:

1) Short-lived presigned S3 bundle + separate passphrase exchange (recommended)
   - Bundle is encrypted at rest; presigned link valid for 7 days by default, can be shortened.
   - We deliver the passphrase via our secure evidence portal (one-time view) or via your secure portal contact.

2) Ephemeral secure viewer (SecureEvidenceVault)
   - Read-only, no-download view with audit trail and session ID; ideal if you want to limit copies.

3) Encrypted SFTP transfer (mutual-auth)
   - For security teams that require direct host pulls and SIEM ingestion; requires a short setup window.

We can provide an executive summary PDF immediately (redacted), and the full appendix once a standard evidence transfer agreement is acknowledged (we typically require either your standard NDA or our mutual NDA). For PII: our reports are redacted by default; raw exploit traces or PoC code are redacted unless a narrow-scope transfer is approved.

I've attached a short checklist with the options and the standard fields we need from your side to configure transfer (user/email for portal, SFTP hostname, or preferred contact for passphrase). If you confirm which option you'd prefer and the contact for verification, our SecOps lead (Irene) will prepare the package.

Hi Danielle—

Thanks Marissa. Danielle — quick operational notes from SecOps: 

- If you choose presigned S3: we will produce a GPG-encrypted tarball (AES-256) and create a presigned GET link. The link's default TTL is 168 hours; we can reduce to 24-72 hours on request. We exchange the passphrase via the portal (one-time view) or via a short OOB phone verification to a named SecOps contact.

- For the ephemeral viewer: sessions are limited to 2 hours and require an email-based verification plus IP logging—good for executive reads. No downloads unless you request a packaged download and we enable it.

- For SFTP: we prefer key-based mutual auth. We can host a temporary user for you or perform a push to your inbound host. Setup usually takes 1 business day after we receive the host fingerprint and SSH user details.

Redaction policy:
- Public/executive summary: minimal vuln details, remediation status, CVSS.
- Technical appendix: includes PoC descriptions and sensitive paths; requires approved evidence transfer agreement (simple 1-page).

We will attach the redacted executive summary now so your procurement team can start the SIG review while we prepare the rest. For the full appendix, please confirm: preferred transfer method and a security contact (name + email + phone).

I can also generate an audit bundle (download logs, transfer MD5/SHA256 hashes, access events) if your audit team needs it.

Regards,
